Review Hera?

Reviewers mostly see Hera as a fast, useful way to make motion graphics, promos, and data visuals without the usual After Effects overhead. They repeatedly praise how quickly it turns prompts into polished animations, keeps branding consistent, and saves money or freelancer time. Several also say the team is responsive and improving the product. The main caveat is control: some users want better fine-tuning, external asset uploads, and easier onboarding for non-coders. One reviewer also reported an inaccurate chart, suggesting reliability can still vary.

Hera nails what most video tools miss: staying perfectly on-brand without fighting the editor. Brand kit setup was effortless—logos, colors, and fonts flowed through the templates immediately—so everything looked consistent from the first scene. The presets feel premium (not cheesy), captions and resizing are a click, and exports are crisp. I went from idea to a polished promo in about 15 minutes. The small touches—guideline prompts, smart layout suggestions, subtle motion—save real time. Support was quick and helpful. If you produce social or product videos and care about design quality, Hera is a no-brainer. Big fan.

results.content:
Hi 👋 We’re Chia and Peter, the founders of Hera.

TL;DR:

Creating motion graphics is time-consuming and requires complicated software. Hera uses AI to make motion design radically faster and cheaper, helping users create over 50,000 animations to date.

Problem: Motion design is complicated, time-consuming, and expensive

Peter used to build YouTube channels and produced more than 240 videos. He spent thousands of dollars every week hiring motion designers to create infographics, text animations, or map animations.

There he realized that motion design is mostly about mastering complicated software with many buttons, not actual creative work. Here you can see how complicated, tedious, and time-consuming the leading tool, Adobe After Effects, is:
